name: Italo Moletto-Lobos
subtitle: Remote Sensing Scientist · AI-powered Crop Monitoring & Yield Forecasting
summary: PhD in Remote Sensing with 10 years of research in agricultural monitoring. I build machine-learning and phenology-informed models that turn multi-source satellite and agro-meteorological data into in-season crop yield forecasts and climate-risk assessments, from field-scale winter cereals in Mediterranean Europe to subnational forecasts in seven countries for NASA Harvest.
